text:
**A.** Bill signed and delivered the deed, so it was a valid lifetime gift. It made Bill and Kathy tenants by the entirety, and Kathy took the condominium by survivorship when he died, outside the will. Her prenuptial waiver bars her pretermitted-spouse and other spousal claims against the estate, so Tommy takes the pasture land and Tommy and Julie split the residue.

CONFIDENCE: 86
